workarounds.symptom: [Audit] load_signal accepts non-finite values: one NaN sample gives ISO Zone D and a healthy bearing verdict (pmm-audit:250e32f6d010 pmm-audit:00dc764f85c3 pmm-audit:bb20113f0483)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(acquisition): refuse non-finite samples and sampling rates before analysis. Target files: src/asset_ledger/__init__.py, src/asset_ledger/service.py, src/asset_ledger/snapshot.py. A single NaN sample in a CSV loaded without a warning. The same diagnosis then gave ISO 20816-3 Zone D with `rms_velocity_mm_s=nan`, and also "Bearing appears healthy". The sampling rate had similar holes: (Ref: https://github.com/LGDiMaggio/predictive-maintenance-mcp/pull/85)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Tool error messages are replaced by "Error executing tool <name>" since the mcp 2.x migration
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(tools): forward tool refusals to the model under mcp 2.3+. Target files: src/mcp_tools/_utils.py, src/mcp_tools/acquisition_tools.py, src/mcp_tools/analysis_tools.py. On mcp 2.3 and later, an agent that calls a tool with an unknown `signal_id`, a missing file or a missing manual reads the refusal and the remedy again, instead of the bare `Error executing tool <name>`. Since mcp 2.3.0 the SDK forwards only `ToolError`/`ResourceError` text, so the project's `ValueError`/`FileNotFoundError` refusals stop... (Ref: https://github.com/LGDiMaggio/predictive-maintenance-mcp/pull/77)
